milestone: deployment-fingerprint M0 protocol and client baseline
scope: SH-FP-01/02 executable baseline plus explicit opt-in infra client methods; not full feature delivery or SH-FP-03 deployment acceptance.

checks.name: shared_bundle_integrity_both_directions
checks.detail: Executed from both repositories; all 20 protocol source files and the frozen checksum manifest agree.

checks.name: core_actual_http_client_race
checks.detail: 12 shared scenarios exercised for registration and heartbeat; concurrent rediscovery coalescing, bounded rollback, parameter-error cooldown, omission/clear, capability restoration, response validation and no replay of malformed successful POST. Optional live fixture case is separately exercised below.

checks.name: market_actual_manifest_parser
checks.detail: Actual Marketplace ParseManifest consumes the same golden vectors as the Go and Node references. Marketplace production parser belongs to parallel development, not to this change.

checks.name: actual_core_client_and_market_base_api
checks.detail: Actual Core Go client calls actual Marketplace base instance router using a test-private SQLite fixture. A frozen legacy strict-DTO boundary emits ordinary 400 invalid_input for extended heartbeat fields. This is controlled compatibility evidence, not two deployed instances. Base register/heartbeat reach the actual router and leave exactly one installation instance. Online capability rollback itself is covered by the controlled Core HTTP scenarios.

checks.name: existing_core_config_distribution_install_regression
checks.detail: Includes existing local-upload/installer regressions. Production installer and local-upload handlers were not edited in this M0 change.

checks.name: shared_reference_javascript_eslint
checks.detail: ESLint recommended rules, Node globals, ECMAScript 2024, both conformance.mjs and conformance.test.mjs; temporary config used installed Core tooling, no lint rules disabled.

checks.name: openapi_local_references
checks.detail: YAML parsed; 7 unique operation IDs; all 23 local schema/response references resolved. New endpoint definitions describe the agreed protocol, not currently mounted routes.

checks.name: owned_fixture_process_cleanup
checks.detail: Both recorded test processes are gone and their listener ports are released; test children completed, httptest.Close executed. No user process was stopped.

runtime_boundaries.site_state_and_fetch_policy_files: Acceptance input fixtures; runtime state-machine and real DNS/dialer/egress enforcement remain owner tasks.

isolated_fixture_processes.result: initial test failed because a parallel new handler returned extension-specific code; frozen legacy boundary added, final run passed

data_and_process_safety.fixture_database: Test-private SQLite using the existing newDistributionFixture; not user configuration or application DB.
data_and_process_safety.parallel_work: Other Marketplace production deployment feature changes observed in the working tree were not modified, reverted or counted as this delivery.
